title: Persist the brief as brief-N.txt; prompt is a one-line pointer
action: Per D1: mailbox gains brief_path(bee_dir, job_id, round) and a pointer_prompt(brief_abs_path) helper returning the fixed one-line text. execute_new and execute_continue write the rendered brief to brief-N.txt (atomic) before prompting, then agent_prompt the ONE-LINE pointer instead of the brief body. A brief-file write failure is a typed spawn/continue failure. Tests: brief file exists with the rendered content before the prompt; the prompt sent is single-line and names the absolute brief path; continue writes brief-(N+1).txt.

truths: The prompt delivered to the agent is one line and names the absolute brief-N.txt path
brief-N.txt carries the full rendered brief and exists before the prompt
